name: Dinner Plain
reason: Alpine village base; sources list walks and tours but no distinct sight, and a town is a spot only when the town itself is a draw (COVERAGE: towns).

name: Lake Mountain
reason: Alpine resort with an official page for free summer access, summit walk and boardwalks; permanent seasonal venue.

name: Mount Buffalo Chalet
reason: Parks Victoria names the historic Chalet and its cafe (open weekends) as a visit area; iconic building the public can enter.

name: Lake Catani
reason: Parks Victoria features Lake Catani for swimming and camping among wombats; distinct lake within the park.

name: The Gorge (Mount Buffalo)
reason: Parks Victoria lists The Gorge Day Visitor Area with viewing area, waterfall and sunrise views; its own visitor area apart from the Chalet.

name: Bogong High Plains
reason: Alpine plateau with Wallaces Heritage Trail and historic huts per Falls Creek resort and Wikivoyage; ~110k views, a headline High Country draw.

name: Mount Cobbler Walking Track
reason: Only Wikivoyage Alpine NP lists it, with no description; a recognised plateau day walk but I found no second counted source or visit detail. For: named day walk. Against: unverified, strenuous remote.

name: Dartmouth Dam
reason: Listed first under See and do on Wikivoyage Alpine National Park; Victoria's highest dam with lookout. Comparable to Hume Dam, which is a spot.

name: Mount Howitt Walking Track
reason: Victoria's High Country tourism and Bushwalking Victoria describe a 14 km summit day walk along the Crosscut Saw; a named walk the board promotes.

name: Mount Samaria State Park
reason: Parks Victoria: summit 360-degree views, Wild Dog and Back Creek Falls, Rocky Point Lookout.

name: Mount Lawson State Park
reason: Parks Victoria: walking tracks to lookouts and waterfalls, summit picnic area; also named by tourism board.

name: Burrowa-Pine Mountain National Park
reason: National park run by Parks Victoria with Pine Mountain monolith (rock climbing, hiking, lookouts); page opened but with little detail, otherwise nationally recognised.

name: Lake William Hovell
reason: Goulburn-Murray Water recreation guide and Visit Wangaratta list it for swimming and paddling in a designated lakeside recreation area.

name: Milawa
reason: Milawa Gourmet Region is a tourism brand: cellar doors, mustard, cheese and the Milawa food trail; a recognised food and wine stop.

name: Ned Kelly Museum
reason: Wikivoyage Glenrowan lists the Ned Kelly Museum and Homestead (daily 9:30-4); a paid, open attraction about the Kelly siege.

name: Glenrowan Siege Site
reason: Wikivoyage says you can walk the siege site but little remains standing. For: the historic site of Kelly's last stand. Against: minor, short, and the museum covers the story.

name: Beechworth Honey
reason: Wikivoyage's own entry calls it a retail outlet with a beekeeping tour; essentially a shop.

name: Newtown Falls
reason: Wikivoyage Natural listing with no description; short walk at Beechworth. For: only natural sight Wikivoyage lists. Against: minor, single source.

name: Lake Sambell
reason: Two tourism sources name Beechworth's lake with walking track, linking to Lake Kerferd walk in Beechworth Historic Park.

name: Chiltern Athenaeum Museum
reason: Wikivoyage lists a small museum with volunteer curators in a historic town. For: open, heritage building. Against: tiny, one source.

name: Mansfield Zoo
reason: Wikivoyage Mansfield lists the zoo with phone and hours; a paid animal park open daily.

name: The Paps Lookout
reason: One tourism listing; I could not confirm detail beyond a short lookout. For: lookout near Mansfield. Against: short stop, unverified.

name: Eildon
reason: Town wrapper; the draw is Lake Eildon and houseboat hire, and no distinct sight is listed.

name: Mount Beauty
reason: Wikivoyage Tawonga-Mount Beauty lists services and a lookout but the model town itself has no sight; only the gorge walk and Bogong lookout are draws.

name: Mount Beauty Gorge Walk
reason: Wikivoyage describes the West Kiewa Gorge walk to a shaded pool as a few hours' mini adventure with a suspension bridge.

name: Mount Granya Walking Track
reason: Part of Mount Granya State Park (Parks Victoria's summit, lookout and falls), not a separate draw; 10 km track with no distinct sight.

name: Tronoh Dredge Walking Track
reason: Two Visit Bright listings: 1.4 km, 30 minute walk to the historic dredge holes at Harrietville.

name: Banjo Paterson High Country Trail
reason: A new multi-region touring trail launched April 2026, not a place with a stopping point.

name: Yackandandah Gorge Scenic Walk
reason: Explore Yackandandah lists a 1859 gold-sluicing gorge walk (about 75 minutes, waterfalls, wildlife).

name: Wandiligong
reason: Visit Bright covers the heritage village with the Diggings Walk (30 min, Chinese swing bridge) and pub.
